featured_reviews.name: Fatema Habib
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had the worst and rather disappointing in-store experience at the Shopmulmul store in Lower Parel on Sunday, 8th March 2026.

When we entered the store, there were no other customers present. We began browsing and trying on a few pieces, and while doing so, asked the store associate (should have noted her name) if there were other colours, patterns, or similar designs available. Her response was consistently curt and dismissive, repeatedly stating that whatever was on display was all that was available. The interaction felt rather unwelcoming, with little effort made to assist or guide us.

A few minutes later, two other customers walked in, and the change in behaviour from the same associate was quite striking. She immediately became warm and attentive towards them, showing them different colour options on her tablet, explaining that pieces could be ordered from other Shopmulmul stores, and even offering them bottled water. At the same time, we were asked to wait to continue trying outfits, despite having arrived earlier and with only one trial room available.

The contrast in service was difficult to overlook and left us feeling somewhat sidelined as customers. While I had initially shortlisted a few pieces, the experience ultimately discouraged me from making a purchase. My sister did proceed with a purchase but ensured that the feedback regarding the associate’s attitude was shared with the staff at the billing counter. Don't know if the message was passed across to the concerned people or not.

Shopmulmul’s designs are undeniably beautiful, which makes it all the more surprising when the in-store experience falls short of the brand’s aesthetic. In a city where customers have no shortage of choices, thoughtful and consistent service is what truly sustains loyalty. After all, beautiful clothing may draw people into a store, but it is how they are treated that ultimately determines whether they return.

featured_reviews.name: Rupal Vora
featured_reviews.review_text:
Disappointing Shopping Experience Due to Unhelpful Staff

I have been visiting the Mulmul store at Kala Ghoda. The staff is extremely helpful and friendly. The experience is always pleasant.

But recently I went to the Lower Parel store for the first time and it was a very unpleasant experience . I was genuinely interested in purchasing an outfit but unfortunately, the service was extremely disappointing. Despite the fact there was no other  customer in the shop except me and my friend - I was asking multiple times for my size, the salesperson showed no interest in assisting me.

Instead of helping, she chose to chat with a colleague in the back room and completely ignored my requests. It felt as though customer service was the last thing on her mind. I waited patiently, thinking she might eventually come back with the size I asked for, but she  did not. I went to the back room and requested her again; she started to put clothes on hangers and then on the rack. She gave me a outfit which I did not approve of for size trial and showed zero interest. My friend and I walked out of  the store and went to the nearly Jaypore store where the customer service is always exemplary.

A shopping experience should feel welcoming and attentive—especially when a customer is clearly asking for help. Sadly, this visit was the opposite. I left the store frustrated and empty-handed. I hope the management takes steps to address such behavior, as it reflects poorly on the store’s reputation.

Worst brand experience ever. Absolutely unprofessional and unethical. Specially the ONLINE STORE.

I ordered two shirts, both turned out to be oversized and required exchange. What followed was a nightmare. No pickup agent came despite multiple emails, follow-ups, and complaints. There was absolutely no response or action from the brand for weeks. It took 30 days just to resolve the issue for one shirt.

For the second shirt, I was ultimately forced to courier the parcel myself after receiving an email from the brand stating that their delivery partner is not serviceable in my pincode something they conveniently realised only at the time of return, not at delivery.

To make matters worse, while initiating an exchange, the website only allows replacement with products that are significantly more expensive, and does not permit exchange with any cheaper alternatives. This is a deliberate tactic to force customers into purchasing higher-priced items, which is unfair, misleading, and exploitative.

The brand claims to be “premium,” but offers zero premium service, zero accountability, and zero customer care. The entire process has been stressful, frustrating, and completely avoidable.

This has been the worst shopping experience I have ever had. At this point, the only remedy left is to initiate legal action under consumer law. I would strongly advise others to think twice before ordering.

Do Visit.
